kpis.description_fr: NIM Banco Santander FY24. Diversifié Espagne/Brésil/Mexique/US/UK/Pologne. Niveau confortable vs EU pairs.
kpis.description_en: Banco Santander NIM FY24. Diversified Spain/Brazil/Mexico/US/UK/Poland. Comfortable level vs EU peers.

kpis.description_fr: CET1 fully loaded FY24. Solide, cible 12-13%. Marge buybacks €1.5-2Bn/an.
kpis.description_en: CET1 fully loaded FY24. Solid, 12-13% target. €1.5-2Bn/year buyback room.

kpis.description_fr: Clients actifs FY24. Plus grande banque retail EU par clients. 10 grands marchés.
kpis.description_en: Active customers FY24. Largest EU retail bank by customers. 10 major markets.

kpis.description_fr: RoTE FY24. Progresse vs cible 16%+. Discipline allocation capital (One Santander).
kpis.description_en: RoTE FY24. Progressing vs 16%+ target. Capital allocation discipline (One Santander).

kpis.description_fr: Commissions nettes FY24. Pilier diversification revenu (consumer, payment, wealth). Cushion contre cyclicité taux.
kpis.description_en: Net fee income FY24. Revenue diversification pillar (consumer, payment, wealth). Cushion vs rate cyclicality.

kpis_story.description_fr: Plan 2023-2025 : 5 global businesses (Retail, Digital Consumer, CIB, Wealth, Payments) au lieu de 10 silos pays. Cible cost/income 42% + RoTE 16% + €3Md synergies cumulées.
kpis_story.description_en: 2023-2025 plan: 5 global businesses (Retail, Digital Consumer, CIB, Wealth, Payments) instead of 10 country silos. 42% cost/income target + 16% RoTE + €3Bn cumulative synergies.

_notes: BPAQF = ADR of Banco Santander. Source: 20-F FY24 filed Mar 2025.
